title: Zustand selectors and slices: Use bounded state slices, stable primitive selectors, and subscribeWithSelector for targeted subscriptions to a vanilla Zustand store.
description: A complete Zustand 5 state-boundaries lesson using actual vanilla stores, targeted subscriptions and safe client state ownership, including a red starter and offline regression tests.
objectives: Use bounded state slices, stable primitive selectors, and subscribeWithSelector for targeted subscriptions to a vanilla Zustand store.
Repair the zustand-selectors-slices intentionally broken Zustand 5 starter.
Explain what belongs in local, URL or authoritative remote data state.
rubric: I can explain the state ownership principle for zustand selectors and slices.
I can repair the 09.04.02 defect using actual Zustand 5 APIs.
I can identify persistence, privacy and hydration risks needing integration tests.
